The area under the curve y=5−x2 between x=−1 and x=1 and the x-axis is approximated by a left Riemann sum using n subintervals of equal length. What is the expression for the Riemann sum in sigma notation?

a
∑j=0n2n(4−4jn+4j2n)
b
∑j=0n2n(5−4j2n2)
c
∑j=012n(5−4jn+4j2n2)
d
∑j=0n−12n(4+4jn−4j2n2)
e
∑j=1n2n(4jn−4j2n2)
